response.reason: The Abramowitz–Stegun tail approximation has an absolute error in erfc of about 1.5e-7, so the error in Phi is ~7.5e-8, and the GELU output error |x|*ΔPhi scales with |x|: at x ≈ 65504 the error is on the order of 5e-3, far exceeding the required 1e-6 absolute tolerance (it is also borderline near |x| ~ 10-15).
